name: Bash
description: Execute bash commands on the system. Provides shell access for automation and system tasks.

changelog.notes: Context prehook (Fase 2): declares a bash prehook (cwd/platform/git snapshot) injected in the <environment> prompt block of agents with this app installed (flag prompt.environment-context).
Initial release — run shell commands on the system, set a working directory and timeout, and capture the output

args.command: echo "cwd: $(pwd)"; echo "platform: $(uname -s)"; git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "git repo: yes ($(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null))" || echo "git repo: no"
args.description: Environment snapshot for the context prehook
